systemSummary.name: Dagster Asset-Oriented Orchestration Platform
systemSummary.description: Data orchestrator for machine learning, analytics, and ETL pipelines structuring computation around Software-Defined Assets, typed event streams, and durable IO managers.

executionEngine.description: Compiles jobs and asset graphs into execution plans, executing steps via multiprocess, in-process, or Kubernetes executors.

storageLayer.description: Relational storage backends for event logs (SqlEventLogStorage) and run records (SqlRunStorage).

ioManagerLayer.description: Durable input/output management handling artifact serialization and inter-step data exchange.

daemonSubsystem.description: Background daemons for run queue coordination, sensor evaluation, and auto-materialize policies.

durableExecutionModel.assetGraph: Pipelines are defined as declarative Software-Defined Assets with lineage and partition definitions. Runs compile into an ExecutionPlan of discrete ExecutionSteps.
durableExecutionModel.eventLogStream: Execution progress is emitted as strongly-typed DagsterEvent records (STEP_START, STEP_OUTPUT, ASSET_MATERIALIZATION, STEP_SUCCESS, STEP_FAILURE) stored in relational databases.
durableExecutionModel.ioManagement: Step inputs and outputs are managed by IOManagers. Outputs are stored in durable blob storage, allowing failed runs to resume execution from the point of failure without re-running completed steps.
durableExecutionModel.runCoordination: Runs are submitted to a queue and dequeued by QueuedRunCoordinatorDaemon based on tag-level and global concurrency limits.
durableExecutionModel.autoMaterialization: AssetDaemons autonomously evaluate asset data freshness and upstream partition state to trigger reconciliation runs.
